title: Russia Boosts Oil Flows as Middle East War Sends Prices Soaring - Bloomberg.com

title: Copper price recovers from near month low as LME stocks rise - Mining.com.au

title: Some physical oil cargoes top $130 a barrel, nearing April's record, on Saudi disruptions - Reuters
